The '''''Omen''''', later known by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] as the '''''Ship of Destiny''''', was a [[Sith dreadnaught]] serving in [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Sadow tasked the ''Omen'', [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Yaru Korsin]], to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] for use in the upcoming [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Sith invasion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the ''Omen'' and its sister [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attacked]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. As the ''Omen'' fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], it was knocked off-course, causing it to crash-land on the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. There, the surviving [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] crew remained stranded for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. With the help of the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]], the Sith built a [[Kesh Sith Temple|temple]] over the ''Omen''{{'s}} crash site. In [[41 ABY]], however, the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] arrived on Kesh and took the Sith off-world, assisting them in ambushing starships in order to [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenge]] parts to rebuild the ''Omen''. They were soon successful, and the ''Omen'' became one of the first vessels in the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Tribe's fleet]].

==Description==
The ''Omen'' was a [[Sith dreadnaught]], a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] resembling a [[lanvarok]] in appearance. The dreadnaught was on at least one occasion used to carry the resources required for [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]], although it was also classified as a [[Warship/Legends|warship]].<ref name="CC" /> The vessel could carry an [[Squadron/Legends|assortment]] of [[Blade-class starfighter|''Blade''-class starfighters]].<ref name="LT1" /> Also, as a Sith dreadnaught, the vessel was powerful&mdash;even by [[41 ABY]], when the vessels were thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] out of date, Sith dreadnaughts were seen as serious threats with ample firepower.<ref name="CC" />

==History==
The ''Omen'' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] dreadnaught in use by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] tasked the ''Omen'', under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yaru Korsin]], and another dreadnaught, the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], to mine [[Lignan]] ore for use in the upcoming invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The two Sith vessels found Lignan in [[Phaegon III's largest moon|the largest moon]] of [[Phaegon III]], but they were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="LT1" /> Despite deploying their starfighters, the Jedi [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] rammed the ''Harbinger'', causing it to crash into the ''Omen'' right as the ''Omen'' jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to flee.<ref name="CC" /> The collision knocked ''Omen''{{'s}} jump off course, causing it to crash-land on the remote<ref name="LT1" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="LT1" />

[[File:KeshSithTemple.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The Kesh Sith Temple was built over the ''Omen''.]]
Soon after, a [[Duel near the Omen|duel]] took place on the crash-site of the ''Omen'' between Yaru Korsin and his half-brother, [[Devore Korsin]], when Devore tried to claim command of the Sith over Yaru. Yaru defeated Devore and retained control over the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|surviving Sith]].<ref name="LT1" /> Eventually, with help from the planet's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]]&mdash;who believed the newcomers to be their [[Deity/Legends|gods]], the [[Skyborn]]&mdash;they built a [[Kesh Sith Temple|new temple]] over the ship's remains in the [[Takara Mountains]].<ref name="LT2">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref><ref name="Omen" /> The Sith then began to mine the world in search of materials with which to rebuild the [[Warship/Legends|warship]]; however, such materials were never found,<ref name="LT2" /> and the Sith remained stranded on the planet for over 5,000 years. The members of the Sith Tribe eventually began to call the vessel the "Ship of Destiny."<ref name="Omen" />

In 41 ABY, the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] known as [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] arrived on Kesh and made contact with the Tribe. It took several of the Sith on missions to attack starships passing nearby, to raid them for parts to rebuild the ''Omen''. Once it was repaired, the ''Omen'' became one of the first ships in the Tribe's new [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]].<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Omen'' was first introduced in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'' the first [[eBook]] in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series. The vessel was first identified as the "Ship of Destiny" in the second [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''.
